title: Sea Library
story: Books, lamps and curious treasures in a reading hall beneath the waves.

cards.name: Diving Helmet
cards.subject: A round brass diving helmet with a front glass window, two smaller side windows, a bolted collar ring at the bottom and a small valve on the side.
cards.hero_colors: brass gold, pale glass, small red valve

cards.name: Bookshelf
cards.subject: A tall wooden bookshelf with four shelves packed with plain books with star icons on their spines, standing upright against a stone wall on a tiled floor.
cards.hero_colors: wood brown, books in red, orange and cream, small gold star icons
cards.surface_or_setting: against a stone library wall on a tiled floor

cards.name: Globe
cards.subject: A perfectly round desk globe with blue oceans and green land, tilted in a brass half-ring arm attached to a round wooden base.
cards.hero_colors: ocean blue, green, brass gold, wood brown base

cards.name: Open Book
cards.subject: An open book seen from above with two curved cream pages showing simple line icons of a wave and a shell, a brown cover and a red ribbon bookmark lying in the middle.
cards.hero_colors: cream pages, brown cover, red ribbon

cards.name: Lantern
cards.subject: A brass lantern with four glass sides, a pointed cap with a ring handle on top and a round base, glowing warm yellow inside.
cards.hero_colors: brass gold, glowing yellow, small dark red glass trim

cards.name: Card Catalog
cards.subject: A wooden cabinet of small square drawers in three rows of four, each with a brass knob and a small empty brass frame, standing on four short feet.
cards.hero_colors: wood brown, brass knobs, small cream drawer frames

cards.name: Book Stack
cards.subject: A stack of four closed books of different sizes lying flat, with cream page edges and a green ribbon bookmark hanging from the top one.
cards.hero_colors: burgundy red, orange, brown, cream edges, small green ribbon

cards.name: Library Sign
cards.subject: A round wooden sign with an open-book icon in cream, hung from a curved iron bracket bolted to a stone wall.
cards.hero_colors: wood brown, iron grey bracket, cream book icon
cards.surface_or_setting: a rough stone wall by the library entrance

cards.name: Message Bottle
cards.subject: A clear glass bottle with a light brown cork stopper, holding a rolled cream scroll tied with a red ribbon.
cards.hero_colors: clear glass, light brown cork, cream scroll, red ribbon

cards.name: Yellow Fish
cards.subject: A single small yellow fish with a rounded body, a flowing tail, top and side fins and one round eye, swimming sideways.
cards.hero_colors: sunny yellow, orange fins, small red stripe

cards.name: Diving Helmet
cards.subject: A round copper diving helmet with a front glass window, two smaller side windows, a bolted collar ring at the bottom and a small valve on the side.
cards.hero_colors: copper brown, pale glass, small red valve

cards.name: Bookshelf
cards.subject: A tall wooden bookshelf with three shelves of plain books with wave icons on their spines, built into a stone alcove and standing on a tiled floor.
cards.hero_colors: wood brown, books in red, orange and cream, small gold wave icons
cards.surface_or_setting: a stone alcove in the library wall with a tiled floor

cards.name: Seahorse
cards.subject: A single orange seahorse swimming upright, with a curled tail, a small snout, a ridged back and one round eye.
cards.hero_colors: orange, cream belly, small yellow fin

cards.name: Open Book
cards.subject: An open book seen from above with two curved cream pages showing simple icons of a fish and a star, and a red cover.
cards.hero_colors: cream pages, red cover, small gold corner

cards.name: Globe
cards.subject: A perfectly round desk globe with blue oceans and green land, tilted in a brass half-ring arm attached to a round wooden base.
cards.hero_colors: ocean blue, green, brass gold, wood brown base

cards.name: Inkwell
cards.subject: A round navy-blue glass inkwell with a short neck, holding one long red feather quill that rests in the opening.
cards.hero_colors: navy blue glass, red feather

cards.name: Magnifier
cards.subject: A round magnifying glass with a clear lens in a brass rim and a short straight wooden handle joined to the rim.
cards.hero_colors: brass gold, wood brown handle, clear glass

cards.name: Book Cart
cards.subject: A wooden book trolley with two shelves loaded with books with fish icons on their spines, four small wheels and a push handle fixed at one end.

cards.name: Hourglass

cards.name: Library Door

cards.surface_or_setting: a stone wall at the library entrance with a sandy step

cards.hero_colors: brass gold, pale glass, small red valve

cards.name: Bookshelf
cards.subject: A tall wooden bookshelf with four shelves packed with plain books with star icons on their spines, standing upright on four short feet.
cards.hero_colors: wood brown, books in red, orange and cream, small gold star icons

cards.name: Lectern

cards.hero_colors: wood brown, cream pages, red ribbon bookmark

cards.name: Octopus

cards.name: Book Stack

cards.name: Reading Glasses
cards.subject: A pair of round glasses seen from the front, with two clear lenses in thin frames joined by a bridge, and two arms reaching back.
cards.hero_colors: deep red frame, clear lenses, small gold hinges

cards.name: Scroll

cards.hero_colors: cream parchment, red ribbon

cards.name: Potted Kelp

cards.hero_colors: kelp green, terracotta orange pot

cards.name: Porthole
cards.subject: A round brass-ringed porthole window with eight bolts, set in a stone wall, with warm lit bookshelves seen through the glass.

cards.surface_or_setting: a curved stone wall of the library seen from the sea
